messages:
oncall-bot: PAGER: Observed billing/metering anomaly — token-count drift > 10% vs 24h baseline for emitters-prod. Severity: 2. Alert: BMD-1748123456.

devon: oncall here, taking it. seeing elevated shadow vs canonical counts on recent windows. pausing outbound overage notifications. :warning:

yara: quick query I ran against live rollups:

```
SELECT emitter_id, sum(tokens) as tokens, sum(shadow_tokens) as shadow_tokens, (shadow_tokens - tokens) as delta
FROM metering.emit_rollup
WHERE window_start >= now() - interval '20 minutes'
GROUP BY emitter_id
ORDER BY delta desc
LIMIT 8;
```

Top offenders: emitter-9 (+11k), emitter-3 (+6.7k), emitter-14 (+1.2k). logs show repeated ack receipts from proxy around ts 1748123200 — possible duplicate deliveries.

kevin: noticed a recent infra config flip on proxy producer: `producer.max.in.flight` set to 10 -> 50 in last deploy. rolling that back to 10 on a canary host now. also bumping emitter retry jitter to avoid tight replays.

emma: CS: are customers currently getting overage flags? any immediate noise?

devon: notifications paused at 1748123488 via `POST /admin/notifications/pause?reason=billing_anomaly`. will confirm no new emails.

yara: kicking off `metering:shadow_recon:1748123500` (read-only replay of 20m window) to reconcile shadow vs ledger.

oncall-bot: NOTE: Handoff scheduled to infra team if not mitigated in 40m. tagging @kevin.

kevin: rollback applied to canary at 1748123520. monitoring producer metrics. producer_retries down but ack latency still elevated (1.9s).

yara: health checks: emitter queue depths OK; kafka consumer lag briefly rising then recovered; redis ephemeral counters stable.

devon: running local recon script to diff token aggregates vs payment ledger. log: /var/tmp/recon-1748123550.log

emma: prepping a short CS note: "We detected inflated token counts for a subset of requests. Overages paused; recon in progress. No charges finalized until complete. ETA 1-3h." will hold until we have firm numbers.

accounting-bot: Last consistent billing checkpoint at 1748122000. uncommitted window size ~19k tokens.

yara: shadow_recon shows majority of surplus attributed to emitter-9. consumer group `metering-shadow-consumer` experienced a restart at 1748123221; lag drained after restart.

kevin: rolling rollback to prod at 1748123580 (config c8f4b -> prev). applying emitter backoff 1.5s -> 5s as temporary mitigation.

devon: initial diff from recon: +18,842 shadow tokens vs ledger, mostly emitter-9 and emitter-3. starting idempotent backfill job with audit mode on. job id: backfill-1748123600.

emma: once you have an interim summary I can notify the top affected accounts. we want to avoid surprise invoice noise.

yara: draft internal CS note: "We observed a metering replication issue that temporarily inflated token counts for a subset of emitters. Overages and notifications are paused while we reconcile. No billing actions will be applied until reconciliation completes. Estimated resolution 1-4 hours."

devon: agreed, posting to #customer-impact and pausing any scheduled billing runs.

oncall-bot: UPDATE: Mitigations deployed (producer rollback + increased backoff). Please update thread with final reconciliation. If unresolved at 1748126800 escalate to oncall lead.

kevin: delta is trending down — now ~2.7% across aggregate windows. keeping eyes on it.

yara: backfill job finished in audit mode at 1748123640; applying corrective deltas with full audit trail.

accounting-bot: Dry-run of billing after corrections shows projected customer charge delta = $0.00 (corrections flagged for manual review).

emma: sent proactive note to top 8 impacted accounts at 1748123655 with the internal draft.

yara: final reconcile done at 1748123675. net residual +27 tokens (within normal variance). re-enabled notifications at 1748123680.

devon: closing pager. please file a postmortem with timeline, root cause likely interaction between increased `max.in.flight` and ack-retry behavior; assign to @kevin and @yara.

kevin: will take RCA and propose a pre-deploy test to catch producer inflight regressions.

emma: CS follow-up scheduled, no charges applied, customer impact = low.

oncall-bot: PAGER CLOSED: Incident BMD-1748123456 mitigated at 1748123680. Tags: [billing, metering, proxy, rollback, customer-impact].
